create.name: Jordanna Levin
create.bio:
Jordanna Levin is a writer and astrologer who came to spiritual subjects by way of journalism. For years she kept her astrology studies to herself, worried they would cost her credibility as a reporter, before choosing to write openly about manifestation and the stars in the light, funny voice of a magazine columnist. Her first book, Make It Happen, tells how she realised she was shaping events rather than foreseeing them and sets out exercises for working with intention. Higher Love carries those ideas into dating, Make You Happen turns them towards self-knowledge, and All Signs Point to You walks readers through the twelve zodiac signs month by month.

She spent five years training in astrology and works in an evolutionary style, reading natal charts and transits for clients over Zoom. Her podcast Lunar Lover follows the lunar cycle, and she is preparing Celestial Storytelling, a two-level course that takes beginners through to interpreting a whole chart, with the next intake due in January 2027. Interactive journals collect the prompts from her books for readers who want to do the work on paper. Self-awareness is the thread through all of it, and she writes and records from Byron Bay in New South Wales.

books.title: Make It Happen: Manifest the Life of Your Dreams
books.author: Jordanna Levin
books.description: Her first book, a personal and often comic account of learning that her expectations were shaping what happened to her. It pairs the story with practical prompts for setting intentions and following them through.

books.title: Higher Love: Everything You Need to Manifest More Love in Your Life
books.author: Jordanna Levin
books.description: A guide to dating with intention rather than by chance. Levin asks readers to look at the part they play in their own love stories and to get clear on how they want a relationship to feel.

courses.title: Astrology readings with Jordanna Levin
courses.description: One-to-one natal chart and transit readings held over Zoom. Levin explains the chart in everyday language, as a tool for understanding yourself rather than for predicting the future. Booking slots open two months at a time.

courses.title: Celestial Storytelling 2027
courses.description: Her two-level online astrology course, which teaches the building blocks of a chart and how to interpret one for yourself and others. The next round opens in January 2027; the waitlist hears first about enrolment and early pricing.

courses.title: Interactive journals for Make It Happen, Higher Love and Make You Happen
courses.description: Fillable PDF workbooks that gather every exercise from her three manifestation books, each over sixty pages long. They can be bought one at a time or as a set of three.
courses.price: $14.99 each or $35.00 for the bundle (currency not stated)

free_resources.title: Jordanna Levin on Insight Timer
free_resources.description: Guided meditations for setting intentions and visualising goals, along with yoga nidra, chakra and simple breathing practices. All free to play.
